feed.subtitle: Apps I built because I wanted them to exist: what's live and what's on the workbench.

entry.title: Keys Boating Report
entry.summary: Wind, tides and seas for the Florida Keys, and what the day on the water is good for.
entry.content:
A morning boating report for the Florida Keys: wind, seas, tides and visibility rolled into a simple go / maybe / stay-in call, plus the day’s best bet, whether that’s lobstering, diving, a sandbar day or offshore fishing.

On the Workbench: Planning the data sources and the scoring.

What’s next:

  • Pick the buoys and tide stations from Key Largo to Key West
  • A first daily rating for boating conditions
  • Activity picks, with the lobster season calendar

entry.title: Loop Lab
entry.summary: A 16-step loop maker with sounds built from scratch in the browser.
entry.content:
A one-bar step sequencer: six sounds, a 16-step grid, tempo, and play. Every sound is synthesized with Web Audio, so there are no samples, no sign-in and nothing uploaded.

On the Workbench: Six sounds, three save slots and WAV export all work.

What’s next:

  • Still deciding what comes next

Open Loop Lab

entry.title: Wall Street Ledger
entry.summary: All your investment accounts in one place, with live prices.
entry.content:
See your investment accounts from different brokers in one place, with live prices and how your mix compares to your targets.

On the Workbench: Imports and live prices work; getting it ready to publish.

What’s next:

  • Publish it
  • Import from more brokers
  • Charts of portfolio value over time
  • A short weekly summary of what changed

entry.title: Krillion Code Breaker
entry.summary: Press Run and watch a Claude-powered bot play krillion.io’s daily dive against me.
entry.content:
A bot that plays krillion.io’s daily trivia dive once a day on its own account, picking each answer with Claude under the same 25-second clock. Press Run on the page and watch it play live, then see whether it beat my score.

Live: Plays krillion.io’s daily dive against me, once a day.

What’s next:

  • Track which kinds of prompts the bot wins and loses

Open Krillion Code Breaker
